title: 换脸App做到2.5亿下载，他的秘诀是病毒式传播
title_en: Face-Swap App Hit 250M Downloads, His Secret Was Virality
title_jp: 顔交換アプリが2.5億ダウンロード、秘訣はバイラル
title_ar: تطبيق تبديل الوجوه حقق 250 مليون تحميل، سره كان الانتشار الفيروسي

author: 阿星

{"ops": [{"insert": "换脸App做到2.5亿下载，他的秘诀是病毒式传播"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 1}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "a16z投资的乌克兰团队，用GAN技术打造爆款", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Dima Shvets以前是干嘛的？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "VC。在东欧跑了5年种子基金Imperious Group。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "然后自己跳下去创业了。 questionable financial decision，big leap of faith。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "结果？Reface，换脸App，2.5亿+下载，a16z投了550万美元。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "一、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "作为CEE地区的VC，Dima一直在找全球可扩展的deep tech。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他发现两件事："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "乌克兰有世界级工程师，但大多困在outsourcing里，而不是做产品。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Deep tech有防御性——有对团队，能build出难复制的东西。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "然后同事介绍了Reface的联合创始人Roman Mogilnyi、Oles Petriv、Yaroslav Boiko。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "那时候GAN（生成对抗网络）刚emerging。团队给他看早期的face-swap prototype，他瞬间懂了。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "赌团队、赌技术、赌defining a new market的潜力。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "二、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Reface的核心是什么？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "自己的face-swap模型，基于GAN技术。建了ML infrastructure，能并行多个AI模型，同时保持lightweight，consistent results。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "App用AI算法精准map facial features，实现视频和图片中无缝换脸。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这是最早实现real-time、on-device face swap的团队之一。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "（联合创始人可能对时间线有争议）"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "从Dima的角度，花了大约一年从cool tech demo变成viral产品——以及a16z的550万美元。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "先launch了网站，用户可以swap照片中的脸，获得关注和正面反馈。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "然后扩展到GIFs和videos，开发Reface App。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他加入时，有："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "一个能在照片上work的face-swap prototype", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "能hire第一个全职工程师的能力", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "筹天使轮、把prototype变成实际产品的计划", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "三、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他们试过B2B。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "和Amazon Video、Universal、Warner Bros.、Saatchi & Saatchi等内容方、创意制作公司、时尚品牌合作。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "做到4.5万美元MRR，但B2B scaling不如预期。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "于是all-in B2C，focus on娱乐、内容创作、virality。B2B合作转作marketing efforts，不是独立业务线。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "赌一个简单、有趣、可能viral的use case——worked。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "四、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "第一个月10万下载。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Product Hunt launch带来早期用户，排名第3，拿了2020年Product Kitty Award。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "2020年8月，成了美国App Store #1，击败TikTok、Netflix、Hulu、Disney+。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "怎么做到的？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "新鲜感效应。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "AI生成的face swap从未如此无缝。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Viral mechanics built into product。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "不只是工具，是娱乐。后面细说。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Celebrity和influencer organic adoption。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "不直接追顶级明星，而是leverage二级名人——A-listers的朋友，更容易reach。然后疯狂tag他们。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他们repost越多，越大牌的人注意到Reface。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "结果Musk、Snoop Dogg、Ariana Grande、Justin Bieber等都organic posting Reface！"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "没有sponsorship，没有付费推广——just strategic outreach。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Press和PR flywheel。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "内部PR团队搞定Mashable、Forbes、The Verge、TechCrunch、Vice、Hypebeast、Business Insider等。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "一旦明星开始post，媒体就疯狂跟进。别忽视PR，early on找能shape story for media的人。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Freemium model。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "免费试用，hooked后付费premium功能。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Content + AI = virality。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "最好的营销不是广告，是人们分享自己的face swaps。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "产品的utility定义增长曲线。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "有些产品天然retentive（习惯养成），有些是hype-driven（需要持续virality）。知道你在build哪种。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "小心付费营销。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "容易用广告spend增长虚荣指标。但performance marketing有时会发错信号，让你远离audience真正想要的。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Organic growth让你connected to audience's needs。如果只靠付费才增长，可能只是在烧钱。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "五、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Viral mechanics是怎么built进产品的？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Watermark：", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "最有效的viral mechanics之一。Dynamic watermark，当时还不太明显。他们做得无法crop掉，确保每个分享的视频都带着Reface branding。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "除了增长，这也是内容moderation工具，防止用于NSFW内容或欺骗性deepfake。每个人都知道视频是Reface生成的，强化信任和authenticity。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Multi-face swaps：", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "注意到用户手动做多脸swap，于是直接built进app。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这tapped into group dynamics。单脸swap有趣，但常一对一分享。多脸swap完美适合group chats，天生social体验。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这个shift boosted peer-to-peer sharing，比公开社交post更多，驱动巨大organic growth。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "In-App内容：", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "作为娱乐产品，紧跟文化趋势：超级碗、情人节、meme时刻——围绕这些做内容。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "也监测organic traffic spikes并capitalizing。如果TikToker开始婚礼face-swap trend，他们确保app里有更多婚礼主题内容。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "六、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "最难的部分是什么？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "当Elon Musk retweet Reface视频时，scaling AI。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "一夜之间几百万下载，backend没准备好。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "两周 chaos，工程师figure out如何scale到100万+ DAU而不把产品搞崩。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他们scale了backend，优化AI processing，没丢失任何viral wave。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "七、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Dima的三条建议："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Support system是一切。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Focus on健康、家庭、mental clarity。创业是马拉松加持续sh*tstorm——你的endurance定义能否survive。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "每个决策都是数字游戏。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "不可能不犯错，但如果好决策多于坏决策，你就赢了。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "招错人比不招人cost更多。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "每个创业公司都在struggle以产品速度scale团队。事后看，团队人越少越好。用AI自动化和优化workflow，保持团队small。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "大团队导致blurred values、diluted team vibe、higher risk of招到toxic或inefficient的人。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "推荐的书："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "The Hard Thing About Hard Things（Ben Horowitz）——对创业诚实到残酷", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Zero to One（Peter Thiel）——关于building monopolies和outside competition thinking", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "The Daily Stoic（Ryan Holiday）——entrepreneurial mindset和resilience", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "写在最后"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Reface的故事是技术+时机+病毒传播的完美结合。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "GAN技术刚成熟，AI换脸概念新鲜，团队执行力强。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "但最关键的是——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他们把viral mechanics built进产品本身。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "不是做完产品再想办法营销，而是产品天生就是可传播的。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Watermark、多脸swap、社交分享——每一步都在放大传播。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "2023年Dima卸任CEO，去做新的AI infra dev tool，还在stealth。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Reface之后，他会带来什么？值得期待。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "原文来自Indie Hackers，由AI翻译并改写", "attributes": {"italic": true}}]}
